options.content: **Traffic and load across the grid.** Requests enter at the front door (__FRONT_DOOR_LABEL__), the hub gateway picks a site by measured availability, and each site's operator relays what its EPP sees. Arrow width is share of traffic, color is saturation against the learned ceiling.

panels.title: Where traffic goes, and how loaded each site is
panels.description: Arrow width is each cluster's share of routed requests over the last minute; arrow and box color is its saturation (rho, in-flight over the learned ceiling): green has room, amber is near the ceiling, red is at it. Grey means unmeasured. All inputs are relayed from each site's EPP by its operator; the gateway counts nothing of its own.

panels.title: Share of routed requests per cluster
Saturation per cluster (rho, 1.0 is the learned ceiling)
In flight against the learned ceiling, $cluster
Shedding by model (1 = every site full)
Site identity, time left
panels.description: The hub's own site identity. The lab issues 4 h identities and rotates at a third left; a negative value is an expired identity and a grid that cannot talk to itself.
